initial_state.meaning: The courier service does not hold any blood units initially; it only transports them.
initial_state.name: no initial units

process_behavior.meaning: The courier service transports shipments from the Cascade regional blood centre to St. Vincent regional hospital. A shipment takes about 3 hours to reach the hospital and be received into its bank.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The courier service operates on Tuesdays and Thursdays, departing at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles, and delivering approximately 3 hours later.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: Not applicable; the courier service does not have a rate, but each shipment takes approximately 3 hours for delivery.

authority.meaning: The centre operates the mobile collection drive.
The centre operates the mobile collection drive.
The centre dispatches the shipment on Tuesday at 4:00 PM.
The centre dispatches the shipment on Thursday at 4:00 PM.

channels.latency_meaning: About 3 hours from departure to receipt.
